name: Sahana Vegetarian Restaurant (Hotel Gnanam)
signature_dish: Vegetarian thali — North and South Indian dishes on one plate
why_it_matters: Sahana is the pure-vegetarian multi-cuisine restaurant of Hotel Gnanam on Anna Salai Market Road — one of Thanjavur's most popular dining addresses, with over a thousand reviews. The thali and buffet breakfast are the draws, served quickly at reasonable prices in an elegant air-conditioned room near the city centre.
insider_tip: Order the thali — Hotel Gnanam's kitchen is best known for its quick, reasonably-priced thali. Buffet breakfast is excellent value. Sits beside the non-veg Diana restaurant in the same hotel. Central location near the bus stand. Cash + cards.
signature_address: Hotel Gnanam, Anna Salai Market Road, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613001

name: Diana Restaurant (Hotel Gnanam)
signature_dish: Biryani thali and non-vegetarian South Indian dishes
why_it_matters: Diana is the non-vegetarian restaurant and bar at Hotel Gnanam, side-by-side with the vegetarian Sahana — a lively air-conditioned room serving North and South Indian non-veg, Chinese and a bar. It is the most reliable place in central Thanjavur for biryani and non-vegetarian dining with a drink.
insider_tip: If you want a non-veg meal or a drink in Thanjavur, this is the dependable choice in the centre — Sahana next door covers the pure-veg side. Biryani is the order. Cash + cards.
signature_address: Hotel Gnanam, Anna Salai Market Road, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613001

name: Les Repas (Hotel Parisutham)
area: G A Canal Road (near Big Temple)
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine dining and South Indian breakfast buffet near the Brihadeeswarar Temple
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Hotel Parisutham, a long-running hotel about 1km from the Brihadeeswarar 'Big Temple' — its Les Repas multi-cuisine restaurant and South Indian breakfast buffet make it the comfortable, hotel-grade dining option for travellers visiting the UNESCO temple.
insider_tip: The South Indian breakfast buffet is the best-value way to eat here. Convenient if you are basing yourself near the Big Temple. Hotel parking. Cash + cards.
signature_address: Hotel Parisutham, 55 G A Canal Road, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613001

name: Vasantha Bhavan
area: South Rampart, near Old Bus Station
signature_dish: Veg thali and South Indian breakfast tiffin
why_it_matters: A popular pure-vegetarian restaurant on South Rampart near the Old Bus Station — Vasantha Bhavan is one of Thanjavur's reliable everyday tiffin-and-meals halls, serving veg thalis and South Indian breakfast at honest prices. The default cheap, clean walk-in meal in the centre.
insider_tip: Good for an early breakfast before sightseeing or a quick lunch thali. Near the Old Bus Station, so handy when arriving or leaving. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: South Rampart, near Old Bus Station, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613001

name: Sree Ariya Bhavan
signature_dish: South Indian tiffin and multi-cuisine vegetarian dishes
why_it_matters: A well-rated vegetarian restaurant in central Thanjavur covering South Indian tiffin, North Indian and Chinese — Sree Ariya Bhavan is among the higher-rated everyday eateries in town on TripAdvisor, a dependable family option for a clean multi-cuisine vegetarian meal.
insider_tip: A solid middle-ground choice — more variety than a plain tiffin hall, more affordable than the hotel restaurants. The dosa and tiffin items are the safe order. Cash + cards + UPI.
signature_address: Thanjavur city centre, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613001

name: Junior Kuppanna
signature_dish: Kongunadu-style mutton biryani and non-vegetarian South Indian dishes
why_it_matters: The Thanjavur outlet of Junior Kuppanna, the well-known Kongunadu (western Tamil Nadu) non-vegetarian chain — a popular address for mutton biryani, country-chicken curry and South Indian non-veg dishes, giving Thanjavur a reliable option for hearty meat-forward Tamil food.
insider_tip: Order the mutton biryani and nattu kozhi (country chicken) curry — the Kongunadu non-veg style is the chain's strength. Busy at lunch on weekends. Cash + cards.
